quotes.text: First time on a jet ski and I felt totally safe. The training was thorough and the sunset view of NYC from the water is something I'll never forget.
Got within 500 feet of the Statue of Liberty on a jet ski — way better than any boat tour. Guides were incredible and the photos came out unreal.
Did this for my bachelor party — 8 of us, super easy from the PATH train. The Manhattan loop tour was the highlight of the whole weekend.
Skipped the helicopter tour and did this instead — half the price, twice as long, and you actually drive. No contest.
